name: Tominator T-72
description: An evolution of tominator-t71-stock-market-2: the same event-reaction/mean-reversion/risk-control core, plus mode-aware leverage (levering the mean-reversion signal only in SYNTHETIC mode, where the price process is structurally bounded, never in HISTORICAL mode's real, possibly-trending data), realized-volatility-scaled sizing, and an order-flow confirmation signal from the previous round's net demand.
